paper_title: A SQUID-based microwave cavity search for dark-matter axions
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 5
notes: First ADMX result with a microstrip SQUID amplifier. Paper excludes KSVZ dark-matter axions at 90% CL for masses 3.3-3.53 ueV assuming local density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (virialized model; also considers low-dispersion unvirialized model). No numerical table given; the exclusion plot (Fig. 5) is not machine-readable here, so data points are the KSVZ coupling values at the stated mass endpoints, representing the approximate excluded coupling level.
